ANATHEMA PSYKANA
You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army (pg 118-120), even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword.
When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated:
- You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction.
- You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.description:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE
Maximum distance: 3"
ELIGIBLE IF: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit:
- Embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield.
- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase.
EFFECT: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02).
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

armyRuleChanges.name: Martial Ka'tah
armyRuleChanges.description:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka'tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.

Each ka'tah ability will tell you when that ka'tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka'tah ability has on the unit using it.

CONSERVAI (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
- Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
- Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

CALISTUS (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.

SALVUS (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit's:
- BS.
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.

DACATARAI (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

KAPTARIS (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

RENDAX (Ka'tah Ability)
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

FAVOURED KA'TAH
All detachments tagged 'Unique: Shield Host' state a Favoured Ka'tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka'tah ability that is the Favoured Ka'tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.
Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka'tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

STRATAGEMS

Gilded Champion (1CP)
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one additional time, but not in the same phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

Duty Unto Death (1CP)
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if that model is a CHARACTER model:
- On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has:
- Stealth.
- Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle round, per army) At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
- On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

detachments.name: Honoured Companions
detachments.ruleText:
While a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an objective, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

STRATAGEMS

Emperor's Domain (1CP)
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move's Before Moving restrictions.
This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

Avenge the Fallen (1CP)
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks (excluding those made by CHARACTER models) have +2 A.

Swift as the Eagle (1CP)
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries
enhancements.description:
TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

detachments.name: Lions of the Emperor
detachments.ruleText:
At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.

STRATAGEMS

Vigil Unending (2CP)
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

Unleash the Lions (1CP)
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that has 2+ models.
EFFECT: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.

Fury of the Emperor (1CP)
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.description: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.description:
SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. (Once per phase, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

detachments.name: Might of the Moritoi
detachments.ruleText:
- While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.
- While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit's attacks can:
  - Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  - Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

STRATAGEMS

Honoured Interred (1CP)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has the following ability:
HONOURED INTERRED (AURA): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Unceasing Onslaught (1CP)
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ends an advance move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: - Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
- That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Unstoppable Momentum (1CP)
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi
enhancements.description: (One per army) ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 A, S and D.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.description: (One per army) ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

detachments.name: Grav-Assault Force
detachments.ruleText:
Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

STRATAGEMS

Victory Before Death (1CP)
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit within range of an objective is destroyed.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.
EFFECT: Select one objective that:
- Your unit was controlling when it was destroyed.
- Has no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) within range of it.
That objective is secured.

Advanced Stabilisers (1CP)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

Inevitable Annihilation (1CP)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit's:
- BS.
- Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.description:
GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT model only. When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a disembark move from this unit, until the end of the turn:
- That unit can re-roll charge rolls.
- Enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Anti-Gravitic Mobility
enhancements.description: GRAV-ASSAULT unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

detachments.name: Null Maiden Vigil
detachments.ruleText:
- When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.
- Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
- Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

STRATAGEMS

Anathema Blademastery (1CP)
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That VIGILATOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
- [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
- Or: [LETHAL HITS].

Psy-chaff Volley (1CP)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
TARGET: That PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is prosecuted until the end of the turn:
- Attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP.

Purgation Sweep (1CP)
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's [TORRENT] attacks have:
- +1 A.
- Or: If those attacks target a PSYKER/battle shocked unit, +2 A.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.description:
ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. This unit's attacks have:
- +1 to hit rolls.
- Or: If this unit targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +1 to hit rolls and wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.description: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

removedUnits: Custodian Guard with Adrasite and Pyrithite spears
